title: Common value types shared across the Canonical Assessment Record (LUVIRA-ASA-008 §19, §4)

opaqueId.description: Opaque machine identity (LUVIRA-ASA-008 §4). No customer/date/severity/environment meaning is encoded or validated here — identity is intentionally content-free. Global uniqueness is a domain invariant this schema cannot enforce by itself.

schemaVersion.description: Canonical data contract version (LUVIRA-ASA-008 §6), distinct from Assessment lifecycle state. Simple MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH string.

timestamp.description: All Canonical timestamps are UTC (LUVIRA-ASA-008 §19). Customer-timezone rendering is a Derived/Output-layer concern, never stored here.
